name: Taxe CO2 on gas oil used as motor fuel
law: Règlement grand-ducal modifié du 17 décembre 2010 fixant les taux applicables en matière de droits d'accise autonomes sur les produits énergétiques, art. 3: the droit d'accise autonome additionnel « taxe CO2 » on gas oil used as motor fuel, EUR 144.60 per 1,000 litres at 15 °C in 2026, as the customs' rate sheet for 2026 gives it (part of EUR 421.87 of excise in all). The excise payer passes it on in the pump price, so a trip pays it where its fuel is bought. Litres are the trip's road fuel as given (diesel_l), or its tank-to-wheel CO2 at 2.67 kg per litre of diesel (EN 16258:2012).

sources.title: Administration des douanes et accises: taux d'accises applicables pour l'année 2026 (from 1 July 2026), incl. gas oil used as motor fuel per 1,000 litres (UEBL excise, accise autonome, contribution sociale, taxe CO2)
